prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, late 30s goddess, glamour hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long curly teal hair — wearing a skin-tight black leather micro-mini skirt with its hem at the very top of her thighs, fully covering her, paired with a single wide black leather belt buckled around her chest as her only top, two fingers tall, pulled tightly across the middle of her bust with a silver buckle at the center front and the strap end tucked short, covering only what it must, leaving the curve of her bust visible above and below it, no other garment on her chest, her stomach fully visible below it. Pose: turned in profile, back arched, looking over her shoulder, one hand on her hip — most extreme glamour hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in glossy black leather with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Russian woman with high cheekbones, light eyes and a defined jaw, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge.

Background: the sunlit arches of the Roman Colosseum with worn stone paving, standard-height arched doorways and low stone steps, empty of tourists, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
